profile.headline: CTO | Architect | Author
profile.summary:
I am a CTO, Architect, and Author with thirty years’ experience across a broad range of high-tech startups and enterprise innovation roles. I have provided technical leadership during multiple rounds of VC fund raising and have extensive experience with early stage strategy, business development, and product management. 

For twenty years I have focused on the creation of innovative products and services that help people make better decisions through the application of data visualization, data analytics, simulation, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. My current interest is in further improving people’s decision-making capabilities through the application of artificial intelligence, digital twins, and augmented / virtual reality.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Azure Incubations Team
positions.description: Part of the Azure CTO's office, the Azure Incubations team is focused on incubating new ideas in partnership with teams across Microsoft and the open source community.

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.description: Architect for the Dynamics 365 Connected Store.

positions.title: CTO WellLine
positions.description: WellLine is a platform that allows organizations to reconstruct the digital histories of their long-lived high-value assets by integrating data from disparate sources into a unified timeline / knowledge graph. WellLine provides users with improved exploration, analysis, and decision-making capabilities and enables API access to enriched and featurized data from which to build higher-level AI-based solutions.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Maana provides a platform on which companies can create an organization-wide knowledge layer of reusable services and models. This simplifies business-focused solution development and accelerates digital transformation in large enterprises.

positions.title: Principal Program Manager, Personal Cloud
positions.description: The Personal Cloud was a large-scale user-centric personalization platform that established a hub for a person’s digital existence and promoted a value-based ecosystem around the user-controlled sharing and use of personal data.

positions.title: Senior Development Lead, Microsoft Fuse Labs UK
positions.description: FUSE Labs worked in partnership with product and research teams to ideate, develop, and deliver new social, real-time, and media-rich experiences.

positions.title: Partner / CTO
positions.description: QuantumBlack is a data science company that helps organizations use data to drive decisions. It combines business experience, expertise in large-scale data analytics, visualization, and advanced software engineering know-how to help organizations prototype, develop, and deploy bespoke data science and data visualization solutions to make better decisions.

positions.title: Director of Product Development / Chief Architect
positions.description: SmithBayes, founded as a joint venture with McLaren F1 Racing Group, developed an innovative agile decision platform that provided a highly visual object-oriented user experience for the creation, visualization, valuation, and performance tracking of strategic business plans.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Principal Objective was a consultancy that provided solution design and development services to a range of UK-based customers including Microsoft, British Airports Authority, and UK Trade & Investment (a department of the UK Government)

positions.title: Senior Project Manager
positions.description: Aspect (originally called OilSpace) developed a Web-based online services platform for the physical oil market. Services included advanced auctioning, real time news and market data, position keeping, risk management, and messaging.

publications.title: AI-Driven Well Timelines for Well Optimization

patents.title: Dynamic Semantic Models Having Multiple Indices
